newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,670 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,670 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,670 contracts compared with 747 overnight Wednesday.
There were 84 wheat, 772 corn, 655 soybean, 104 soymeal, 43 soyoil, six oat, three corn calls, one soybean call and two soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to 1/2 cent higher, corn was 1/4 to 3/4 cent lower and soybeans were 1/2 cent higher to 6-1/2 cents lower.
